title: Duo Link Necklace
descriptionHtml:
Gold and silver, in one line. Long oval links in gold tone and silver tone, mixed along the chain and joined by small stacked gold rings, finished with a lobster clasp and a short extender. It settles at the collarbone and wears well with both metals.

STYLING TIP: Wear it with the Duo Link Bracelet, or with your gold and silver rings together.

Details

  • Length: Approximately 45cm plus a short extender
  • Chain: Long oval links in gold tone and silver tone, approximately 20mm, joined by small stacked gold rings
  • Closure: Lobster clasp with extender
  • Plating: 18k gold tone plated and rhodium plated silver tone
  • Material: Surgical stainless steel

Care

Waterproof and tarnish free, so daily wear and water are fine. Keep it away from perfume and harsh chemicals, wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.
